title: A brief short only of photos builds as a trial site with a note, and a refused brief reads as the brief refusal, not an unexpected error
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A brief blocked only on own photos, photo labels, an opening photo or a template card kind builds as a trial (a measured cafe-like brief with no photo of its own included); a picture with no known source or credit, an empty business reading or an unknown block still blocks; the Build card shows the trial version note with what a full version needs while building and once built; BRIEF_NOT_READY reads as the brief refusal, never as the unexpected error.

tests: a pass or a warn builds; a block on trial checks only builds as a trial
a picture with no known source, an empty business reading or a check the gate does not know still blocks
the stored note reads the same gate: a hard check named in it means it blocked
a brief with no photo of its own but something of the business builds as a trial (the tester's cafe, 25/11/2026)
a trial site says it is a trial version and what a full version needs, while it builds and once built
a build failure reason that is a code reads as its plain sentence; a sentence is shown as is
